name: Maren Holt
tagline: Small-town secrets, strong tea, and one very nosy librarian.
bio: Maren Holt writes cozy mysteries set in a fictional fishing village on the Cornish coast. Before writing full time she spent fifteen years as a school librarian, which explains a lot about her detectives.
She lives with two cats and an unreasonable number of teapots.

books.title: The Lighthouse Ledger
books.description: When the village lighthouse keeper vanishes, librarian Edie Marsh finds a ledger that lists every secret in Porthaven.

books.title: A Body in the Tea Room
books.description: A wedding, a missing cake, and one guest who will not be leaving. Edie is on the case again.

books.title: Low Tide at Midnight
books.description: The tide goes out and takes the village's oldest secret with it. Then it brings something back.

name: Dev Anand
tagline: Quiet, human stories about the people who keep starships running.
bio: Dev Anand is a former marine engineer turned science fiction writer. His novels follow ordinary crews doing difficult work far from home.
He writes on early mornings, before the day job, and posts a free short story to his newsletter every month.

books.title: Ballast
books.description: A freight hauler, a failing reactor, and a passenger who is not on the manifest.

books.title: The Long Watch
books.description: Eleven years into a twelve year voyage, the night crew wakes to find someone has changed the course.

name: Iris Okafor
tagline: Bedtime stories with big hearts and bigger animals.
bio: Iris Okafor writes and illustrates picture books for ages 3 to 7. Her stories are about kindness, curiosity and the occasional grumpy hippo.
She is a primary school teacher in Manchester and tests every book on her own class first.

books.title: Hugo the Hippo Says No
books.description: Hugo will not share, will not wash and will not go to bed. Until tonight.
